sentences.text: Page No.# 2/2 Also heard Mr. K.K. Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. This is an application filed under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023, praying for granting bail to the accused-applicant, namely, Md. Sofikul Ali in connection with POCSO Case No. 127/2025 under Section 449 / 376(2) of Indian Penal Code read with Section 6 of POCSO Act pending before the learned Special Judge (POCSO), Morigaon.

3. Call for the scanned copy of the TCR in connection with POCSO Case No. 127/2025 pending before the learned Special Judge (POCSO), Morigaon.
4.

Let notice be issued to respondent No. 2 through the Office of the learned Public Prosecutor,
Gauhati High Court, which shall be executed by the Officer-in- Charge of Mikirbheta Police Station.

5. Notice upon respondent No. 1 is hereby dispensed with since the learned Addl. PP, Mr. K. K.
Parasar has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of respondent No. 1.
6.
Let the matter be listed again on 18.12.2025.
